code_path_deduction: The direct executable-evidence generator returns all four evaluator oracle families inside its preliminary candidate set.
The PR72 integration inserts every nonempty executable-evidence candidate into the shared `seen` map; that merge operation does not discard an inserted package key.
After that insertion, the remaining filtering step before the returned APT candidate list is the global score sort followed by final top-K truncation.

Therefore the previously observed PR72 disappearance of mediainfo, and the insufficient top-K rank of librsvg2-bin, occur in the post-generator evidence-fusion/global-ranking stage rather than in candidate generation.
repeated_cross_effect_topk_failure_evide: SVG_RASTER: direct generator rank improved to 31 but PR72 final rank was 23, still outside the precommitted top20 bar.
MEDIA_METADATA: direct generator rank 36 survived preliminary top100 but PR72 final returned list omitted mediainfo entirely.

next_frontier.repair_principle: Treat direct executable-plus-semantic evidence as a qualitatively stronger evidence tier than lexical-only package coincidence; use lexical evidence as secondary support rather than allowing flat additive scores to dominate.
